verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect's own docs describe driving core flows through the Stripe API, such as building custom onboarding UIs and retrieving connected-account balances with authenticated API calls. Webhooks, an official CLI and an MCP server round out programmatic access, and community developers report straightforward integrations. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show no spec at those doc paths; they do not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec located by the probe, and a direct citation of the API reference covering endpoints and auth in depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: API onboarding: You use the Stripe API to build your own customized onboarding UI.
To check the balance of a connected account, perform a retrieve balance call authenticated as the connected account.
All Connect integrations should establish a webhook endpoint to listen for Connect events.
The implementation was straightforward, and it instantly made Stripe the easiest integration for our users.
